component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.assets.review.listener
component.documentation:
The review listener, synchronous, in the transaction of the change that fires it, as the user who makes it, or the one a privileged session acts for, as Nuxeo's comment manager opens one to write an annotation: it refuses a decision written by anyone the review policy and ReviewAsset do not let decide, one not of the review's form, one on a version, a proxy or an asset in the trash, and one after the review was approved or rejected; it writes the person as its author; and it keeps a decision as it was written, refusing a change to it, a move, a copy, a trash and a deletion but an administrator's, and an import. Every refusal marks the transaction for rollback. No Automation operation.
Each decision written fires assetReviewDecided, which the writer below adds to the platform's audit, on the asset, once its transaction has committed.
The assetReview document enricher says whether the reader may decide, so that the asset page offers the decisions only to them. It explains; the listener refuses.
